name: planet-chat-cell
description: Real-time multi-user chat cell with distributed state via Redis Pub/Sub and WebSocket

partyId.description: Legacy party/context ID for channel isolation. Superseded by roomName.

roomName.description: Room name for channel isolation. Null = Global Lobby (global-planet-lobby).

maxMessages.description: Maximum number of messages to retain in the local store.

_discovery.describe: Real-time multi-user chat cell powered by Redis Pub/Sub and WebSocket. Supports multiple concurrent users in the same party seeing messages instantly (< 100ms). Uses distributed state synchronisation with append-only conflict resolution to prevent message loss. Ideal for team collaboration, live Q&A, and AI-human communication workflows.
use_cases: Team communication within a notebook party
AI agent and human real-time collaboration
